correctness.rationale: Two independently implemented exhaustive algorithms recover 144 unlabelled/864 named three-edge colourings. Full 720-element group action yields 36 order-five stabilizers with four factorisations each. An order-five orbit argument proves every allowed Kempe cycle is fixed by the stabilizer. The complete unlabelled graph is 36 four-cycles, and breadth-first search from each of the 864 named states gives (1,5,13,5), all checks replayed successfully.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Knowing 288 perfect matchings, or a generic class-count algorithm, does not logically determine the stabilizer fibre theorem, 24-state component isomorphism or exact shortest-path spheres. The present proof needs a complete three-factorization orbit calculation plus an order-five cycle-preservation argument.

value.rationale: A natural extremal cubic cage with exceptional S6 symmetry has its full optimal edge-colouring reconfiguration obstruction identified by classical Sylow subgroups, rather than an arbitrary enumeration. The four-state unlabelled fibres and exact named-state graph give a sharp diameter-three benchmark and a structural explanation of thirty-six separated sectors.
